source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Many people hanker after money, _________ ?
explanation_en: The subject 'Many people' is plural. In present indefinite tense without an auxiliary, we use 'do' for positive tags (negative statement would use 'don't'). The statement is positive, so tag is negative: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Many people' বহুবচন। Present indefinite tense-এ auxiliary না থাকলে positive tag-এর জন্য 'do' বসে (negative statement-এ 'don't')। বিবৃতিটি positive, তাই tag negative: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: But money is not as valuable as morality, _________ ?
explanation_en: The statement is negative ('is not'), so the tag must be positive. 'Money' is singular, so use 'is it'.
explanation_bn: বিবৃতিটি negative ('is not'), তাই tag positive হবে। 'Money' singular, তাই 'is it' বসে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let us always keep this truth in mind, _________ ?
explanation_en: For imperative sentences starting with 'Let us' or 'Let's', the tag is 'shall we'. It invites agreement or suggestion.
explanation_bn: 'Let us' বা 'Let's' দিয়ে শুরু imperative বাক্যের tag 'shall we' হয়। এটি সম্মতি বা পরামর্শ বোঝায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Money can hardly bring happiness, _________ ?
explanation_en: The word 'hardly' has a negative meaning, so the statement is negative. Therefore the tag is positive. The modal 'can' is used: 'can it'.
explanation_bn: 'hardly' শব্দটি negative অর্থ বহন করে, তাই বিবৃতিটি negative। ফলে tag positive হবে। Modal 'can' ব্যবহৃত: 'can it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: So, we should never have greed for money, _________ ?
explanation_en: The statement contains 'never', which makes it negative. So tag is positive: 'should we'.
explanation_bn: বিবৃতিতে 'never' থাকায় এটি negative। তাই tag positive: 'should we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Bangladesh came into being at the cost of a bloody war, _________ ?
explanation_en: Past indefinite tense, no auxiliary → use 'did'. Statement positive, tag negative. 'Bangladesh' is often personified as feminine ('she') in poetic/literary contexts, so 'didn't she'.
explanation_bn: Past indefinite tense, auxiliary নেই → 'did' ব্যবহার। বিবৃতি positive, tag negative। 'Bangladesh' কে প্রায়ই স্ত্রী বাচক ('she') ধরা হয়, তাই 'didn't she'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: So, everyone has some duties and responsibilities to this country, _________ ?
explanation_en: Both 'haven't they' and 'don't they' are accepted. 'Everyone' takes plural pronoun 'they'. 'Has' can be treated as auxiliary (have + past participle) or main verb. Answer sheet accepts both.
explanation_bn: 'haven't they' এবং 'don't they' উভয়ই গ্রহণযোগ্য। 'Everyone' এর জন্য plural pronoun 'they' বসে। 'Has' auxiliary বা main verb হতে পারে – উত্তরপত্রে উভয়ই স্বীকৃত।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: As a citizen of this country, we can hardly forget our duties, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' makes the statement negative, so tag positive. Modal 'can' is used: 'can we'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' বিবৃতিকে negative করে, তাই tag positive। Modal 'can' বসে: 'can we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: I am proud to be a citizen of this country, _________ ?
explanation_en: For 'I am', the tag is 'aren't I' (or 'am I not' in very formal English). 'Aren't I' is standard.
explanation_bn: 'I am' এর জন্য tag 'aren't I' হয় (বা অতি আনুষ্ঠানিক 'am I not')। 'Aren't I' প্রচলিত মানক রূপ।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let us work together to build up our country, _________ ?
explanation_en: Same as 1c – 'Let us' takes 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 1c এর মতো – 'Let us' এর tag 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Patriotism persuades a man to do everything just, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Patriotism' is singular (it). Present indefinite, no auxiliary → 'does'. Statement positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Patriotism' singular (it)। Present indefinite, auxiliary নেই → 'does'। বিবৃতি positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A patriot hardly fears anybody, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' makes the statement negative, so tag positive. Subject 'A patriot' is singular masculine → 'does he' (present indefinite).
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' বিবৃতিকে negative করে, তাই tag positive। Subject 'A patriot' singular পুংলিঙ্গ → 'does he' (present indefinite)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody respects a patriot, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' takes plural pronoun 'they' in tags. Statement positive → tag negative: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Everybody' tag-এ plural pronoun 'they' নেয়। বিবৃতি positive → tag negative: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: What an outstanding quality it is! _________ ?
explanation_en: Exclamatory sentence. Convert to assertive: 'It is an outstanding quality.' Then tag: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Exclamatory বাক্য। Assertive করুন: 'It is an outstanding quality.' তাহলে tag: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let's be patriots, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Let's' is contraction of 'Let us', so tag 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 'Let's' হলো 'Let us' এর সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ, তাই tag 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Slow and steady wins the race, _________ ?
explanation_en: The phrase 'Slow and steady' is considered a singular concept (one idea), so pronoun 'it'. Present indefinite positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'.
explanation_bn: 'Slow and steady' phraseটিকে একক ধারণা ধরা হয়, তাই pronoun 'it'। Present indefinite positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The mother has risen in her to see the orphan, _________ ?
explanation_en: Here 'the mother' is an abstract quality (motherly feeling) that rose in her. Abstract nouns take 'it'. Present perfect positive → tag negative: 'hasn't it'.
explanation_bn: এখানে 'the mother' একটি গুণবাচক ধারণা (মাতৃত্ব) যা তার মধ্যে জেগেছে। Abstract noun 'it' নেয়। Present perfect positive → tag negative: 'hasn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: He hardly cast a vote for me, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' makes negative, so tag positive. Past tense ('cast' is past form) → auxiliary 'did': 'did he'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative করে, তাই tag positive। Past tense ('cast' past form) → auxiliary 'did': 'did he'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Kindly do me a favour, _________ ?
explanation_en: Imperative sentence (polite request). Standard tag for imperatives is 'will you'.
explanation_bn: Imperative বাক্য (নম্র অনুরোধ)। Imperative-এর জন্য সাধারণ tag 'will you'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: I need not go there, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Need' here is a modal auxiliary (negative form 'need not'), so tag uses 'need' in positive form: 'need I'.
explanation_bn: এখানে 'need' modal auxiliary (negative 'need not'), তাই tag-এ 'need' positive রূপে: 'need I'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody believes this truth, _________ ?
explanation_en: Same as 3c – 'everybody' → 'they', positive statement → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 3c এর মতো – 'everybody' → 'they', positive বিবৃতি → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We hardly forget the golden past, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' negative, tag positive. Present indefinite, auxiliary 'do': 'do we'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative, tag positive। Present indefinite, auxiliary 'do': 'do we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Nothing was said, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Nothing' is negative (means 'not anything'), so tag positive. Past tense, 'was' used: 'was it'.
explanation_bn: 'Nothing' negative (অর্থ 'কিছুই না'), তাই tag positive। Past tense, 'was' ব্যবহৃত: 'was it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Don't disturb me, _________ ?
explanation_en: Negative imperative (Don't + verb). Tag is 'will you' (positive) for all imperatives.
explanation_bn: Negative imperative (Don't + verb)। সব imperative-এর tag 'will you' (positive)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let's be sincere in our life, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Let's' → 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 'Let's' → 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: At present extended families are found in rural areas, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'extended families' plural. Present tense 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'extended families' plural। Present tense 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: There're many members in extended families, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'There are' (contracted There're) → tag 'aren't there'.
explanation_bn: 'There are' (সংক্ষেপ There're) → tag 'aren't there'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The house is always full of guests, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'The house' singular (it). Positive statement → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'The house' singular (it)। Positive বিবৃতি → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: It becomes very difficult for one to study, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'It', verb 'becomes' (present indefinite) → auxiliary 'does'. Positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'It', verb 'becomes' (present indefinite) → auxiliary 'does'। Positive → tag negative: 'doesn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: In the same room children are found reading, gossiping and sleeping, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'children' plural. Present tense 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'children' plural। Present tense 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Industry is the key to success, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Industry' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Industry' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The industrious are prosperous, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'The industrious' (plural adjective as noun) → 'they'. Positive → tag negative: 'aren't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'The industrious' (বহুবচন বিশেষণ বিশেষ্যরূপে) → 'they'। Positive → tag negative: 'aren't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: They hardly suffer from poverty, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive. Present indefinite → 'do they'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive। Present indefinite → 'do they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: On the other hand, idleness is a curse, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'idleness' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'idleness' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The idle seldom prosper, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Seldom' has negative meaning → tag positive. Subject 'The idle' plural → 'they'. Present indefinite → 'do they'.
explanation_bn: 'Seldom' negative অর্থ বহন করে → tag positive। Subject 'The idle' plural → 'they'। Present indefinite → 'do they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: None can solve this problem, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'None' is negative, so tag positive. Modal 'can' → 'can they'.
explanation_bn: 'None' negative, তাই tag positive। Modal 'can' → 'can they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody hates them, _________ ?
explanation_en: Same as 3c, 5a – 'everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 3c, 5a এর মতো – 'everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let's do the work, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Let's' → 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 'Let's' → 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Telling lies is a great sin, _________ ?
explanation_en: Gerund phrase 'Telling lies' as subject → singular (it). Verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Gerund phrase 'Telling lies' subject হিসেবে → singular (it)। Verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: How nice the bird is! _________ ?
explanation_en: Exclamatory → assertive: 'The bird is very nice.' Tag: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Exclamatory → assertive: 'The bird is very nice.' Tag: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Patriotism is a noble virtue, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Patriotism' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Patriotism' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Wise people teach us to love our own country, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Wise people' plural, present indefinite (teach) → auxiliary 'do'. Positive → tag negative: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Wise people' plural, present indefinite (teach) → auxiliary 'do'। Positive → tag negative: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We should remember that motherland is above everything, _________ ?
explanation_en: Modal 'should' in positive statement → tag negative: 'shouldn't we'.
explanation_bn: Modal 'should' positive বিবৃতিতে → tag negative: 'shouldn't we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Some people forget it, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Some people' plural, present indefinite (forget) → 'do'. Positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Some people' plural, present indefinite (forget) → 'do'। Positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We hope that everybody will love his motherland, _________ ?
explanation_en: The main clause is 'We hope' but the tag question usually follows the that-clause when the main verb expresses opinion/hope? Actually rule: with 'hope', tag follows the that-clause. 'Everybody will love' → 'everybody' → 'they', positive 'will' → negative tag 'won't they'.
explanation_bn: মূল clause 'We hope' কিন্তু tag প্রশ্ন সাধারণত that-clause অনুসরণ করে যখন main verb আশা/মত প্রকাশ করে। 'Everybody will love' → 'everybody' → 'they', positive 'will' → negative tag 'won't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Modesty is a great virtue, _________ ?
explanation_en: Same as 9a.
explanation_bn: 9a এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The modest always respect their superiors, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'The modest' (plural) → 'they'. Present indefinite positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'The modest' (plural) → 'they'। Present indefinite positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody likes a modest person, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' → 'they' (plural tag), positive → negative: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Everybody' → 'they' (বহুবচন tag), positive → negative: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A modest student hardly fails to reach his goal, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive. Subject 'A modest student' singular masculine → 'does he' (present indefinite).
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive। Subject 'A modest student' singular পুংলিঙ্গ → 'does he' (present indefinite)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let's try to be modest in our way of life, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Let's' → 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 'Let's' → 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: War is a curse of human civilization, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'War' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'War' singular, verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody suffers from it, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Massive destruction is found everywhere, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Massive destruction' singular → 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Massive destruction' singular → 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: None can escape from the bombings of the enemy, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'None' negative → tag positive. Modal 'can' → 'can they'.
explanation_bn: 'None' negative → tag positive। Modal 'can' → 'can they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Women and children are the worst sufferers, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject plural, verb 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject plural, verb 'are' → tag negative: 'aren't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: The habit of reading is good, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'The habit of reading' singular → 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'The habit of reading' singular → 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: But we hardly find it in us, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive. Subject 'we', present indefinite → 'do we'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive। Subject 'we', present indefinite → 'do we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody loves a studious student, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We ought to give him books, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Ought to' is a modal. Positive statement → negative tag: 'oughtn't we'. 'Shouldn't we' is also accepted in modern usage, but answer sheet says 'oughtn't we'.
explanation_bn: 'Ought to' একটি modal। Positive বিবৃতি → negative tag: 'oughtn't we'। আধুনিক ব্যবহারে 'shouldn't we' গ্রহণযোগ্য, কিন্তু উত্তরপত্রে 'oughtn't we' দেওয়া আছে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Books give us knowledge, _________ ?
explanation_en: Subject 'Books' plural, present indefinite (give) → 'do'. Positive → tag negative: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Books' plural, present indefinite (give) → 'do'। Positive → tag negative: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: At present, everybody likes cricket, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Everybody' → 'they', positive → negative tag: 'don't they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Students hardly miss watching this game, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive. Subject 'Students' plural, present indefinite → 'do they'.
explanation_bn: 'Hardly' negative → tag positive। Subject 'Students' plural, present indefinite → 'do they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Nothing is more enjoyable to them than cricket, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Nothing' is negative → tag positive. Verb 'is' → 'is it'.
explanation_bn: 'Nothing' negative → tag positive। Verb 'is' → 'is it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: How exciting the game is! _________ ?
explanation_en: Exclamatory → assertive: 'The game is very exciting.' Tag: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Exclamatory → assertive: 'The game is very exciting.' Tag: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Let's play this game, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Let's' → 'shall we'.
explanation_bn: 'Let's' → 'shall we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Nobody trusts a liar, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Nobody' negative → tag positive. Subject 'Nobody' takes plural pronoun 'they' in tag. Present indefinite → 'do they'.
explanation_bn: 'Nobody' negative → tag positive। Subject 'Nobody' tag-এ plural pronoun 'they' নেয়। Present indefinite → 'do they'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: A liar has to lead a miserable life, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Has to' is a main verb (obligation). So tag uses 'does' for present indefinite. Subject 'A liar' singular masculine → 'doesn't he' (positive statement → negative tag).
explanation_bn: 'Has to' একটি main verb (বাধ্যবাধকতা)। তাই tag-এ present indefinite-এর জন্য 'does' ব্যবহার। Subject 'A liar' singular পুংলিঙ্গ → 'doesn't he' (positive বিবৃতি → negative tag)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Speaking the truth is a good exercise, _________ ?
explanation_en: Gerund phrase subject → singular 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'.
explanation_bn: Gerund phrase subject → singular 'it', verb 'is' → tag negative: 'isn't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Everybody should have the habit of speaking the truth, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Everybody' → 'they', modal 'should' positive → negative tag: 'shouldn't they'.

explanation_en: Subject 'Their contribution' singular (it), future tense 'will be' positive → tag negative: 'won't it'.
explanation_bn: Subject 'Their contribution' singular (it), future tense 'will be' positive → tag negative: 'won't it'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: We should never neglect them, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Never' negative → tag positive: 'should we'.
explanation_bn: 'Never' negative → tag positive: 'should we'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
statement: Every citizen of Bangladesh must have due respect for them, _________ ?
explanation_en: 'Every citizen' → 'they' in tag. Modal 'must' positive → tag negative: 'mustn't they'.
explanation_bn: 'Every citizen' → tag-এ 'they'। Modal 'must' positive → tag negative: 'mustn't they'।
